category: hosted metrics, logs, traces and profiles (observability platform)

free_tier.stated: Free plan, quoted: 'Always free Always', '$0', 'No credit card required', 'Actually useful free tier with access to everything that Grafana Cloud has to offer'. Metrics: 'Limited to 10k active series per month', '14 days retention'. Logs: 'Limited to 50 GB ingested per month', '14 day retention'.

per_object_cap.stated: 256kb per log line (max_line_size, not modifiable) and 5MB per trace (max_bytes_per_trace) by default

retention.stated: 14 days for metrics, logs, traces, profiles and k6 performance tests on the free plan

interface_detail: Every Grafana instance exposes an HTTP API; the Grafana Cloud API (GCOM) manages the resources of a stack programmatically
tooling: the hosted Grafana UI, the Grafana HTTP API and the Grafana Cloud API
chaining: A hosted log, metric and trace store for scripts on free compute: 50 GB of logs a month with 14 days of history, queried from the same hosted Grafana.

limits.value: 10k active metric series per month (a count of series, not bytes)
50 GB of logs, 50 GB of traces and 50 GB of profiles ingested per month
14 days for metrics, logs, traces, profiles and k6 performance tests
256kb per log line; 5MB per trace by default

limits_note: 3 active users per month and 500 k6 virtual user hours per month on the free plan.
binding_note: Metrics stop at 10k active series per month on the free plan; logs, traces and profiles stop at 50 GB ingested each per month.

identity_cost.detail: No credit card required on the free plan; the sign-up page offers Google, GitHub, Microsoft or Amazon sign-in, or an account form.
